Elon Musk on humanoid robots:

Most impressive demos online are pre-programmed or remotely controlled. No current humanoid can handle generalized tasks.

Optimus will be the first to do so — not just for show, but genuinely useful in daily life. It’s designed with human-level (or better) hand dexterity and the ability to understand its environment, learn new tasks, and perform real work in homes and factories.

That’s the goal.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

BREAKING: Tesla generated over $100 billion in revenue on a trailing twelve-month basis for the first time.

While simultaneously making the largest investments in company history into AI, autonomy, Optimus, batteries, and semiconductor manufacturing.

This is the setup phase for the next decade.

Big picture from the letter:

Tesla is in its largest and most exciting investment cycle ever. 
Core vehicle + energy + services businesses are healthy, while the company is building the factories, compute, batteries, and autonomy systems required for the next decade. 

Scaling will be non-linear. Long-term focused.

We’ve never been more optimistic about the future.


Tesla Owners Silicon Valley (@teslaownersSV)

BREAKING: Starlink is supporting Project SPARROW's biodiversity research in Colombia. 🇨🇴🛰️

• Starlink provides connectivity to scientists working in remote regions.
• AI-powered analysis is helping researchers identify wildlife activity and discover new animal behaviors.
• Tasks that once took thousands of hours of manual review can now be completed far more efficiently.
• The project is accelerating conservation efforts through faster access to environmental data.

Starlink is helping bring AI-powered research to some of the world's most remote ecosystems.
